title: Pilot: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, 1 harnesses, openssl
purpose: 1-task pilot of the per-model design's harness arms (same arm and run settings, so the trials share their configuration), before the 27-task design runs.
rationale: Effort high, set on each arm (low/high/max only; Fireworks turns medium into high; never their default max). How each arm sends it: terminus-2: reasoning_effort to LiteLLM; mini-swe-agent: reasoning_effort to LiteLLM; pi: --thinking; strands: model_kwargs.params.reasoning_effort on the model Harbor builds; cline: --thinking; goose: reasoning_effort in the request_params of the custom provider bench/agents/goose.py writes; opencode: the model variant, declared in its entry; kilo: the model variant, declared in its entry.
